using the feedback from earlier, i will ensure that i use correct English and avoid unintended script mixing. i will set a periodic language check for my writing to review proper word boundaries, spacing, spelling, punctuation, and digit usage. this should improve the quality of my output and make it easier to read and understand.

 previously, the dialogue read: "I needed time to myself in the library, away fromsuch distractions,Father." the correct version should be:"I needed time to myself in thelibrary, away fromthesedistractions, Father."

i will implement this change and review my writing more carefully in the future. `\"i needed time to myself in the library, away from these distractions, father.\"` is the corrected dialogue line.

going forward, i will include a language check after each significant task or at least once a day. this will help me learn and improve the quality of my output.

text: [R210_PARENT] “thelibrary, away fromthesedistractions” still joins English words; use “the library, away from these distractions.” No CJK/full-width corruption appears here. Choose a precise cadence for your proposed periodic LANGUAGE CHECK in your own action policy. As a reader, “i needed time to myself” suggests withdrawal but little immediate conflict; perhaps “I came here to be alone, Father.” Return one short revised two-character dialogue: choose a setting, give them opposing intentions, and mark one line revised using this feedback.
